intro: If you're coming to pay respects at Phra That Phanom and want a stay you can walk to the stupa from — no driving in and out — Na That Phanom Place Hotel is the name pilgrims keep mentioning. It's a small 25-room hotel in That Phanom town, about 650 metres from Wat Phra That Phanom, a roughly 9-minute walk. What guests agree on is that the rooms are clean, the beds soft, the A/C cold, and the setting peaceful, since the building sits back off the main road. body.html: Na That Phanom Place Hotel sits at 117 Moo 10, Chayangkul Road, in That Phanom town, Nakhon Phanom province, a little southwest of the great stupa. It's a long two-storey building of 25 rooms, family-run with the owner on site. The reason its name sticks with pilgrims is the location — a roughly 9-minute walk to Wat Phra That Phanom (about 650 metres) — which suits anyone who wants to visit early in the morning without driving in and out.

Rooms are simply and tidily furnished in a clean, modern style, as many guests note. Each has air-conditioning, a TV, a fridge and an en-suite bathroom with a shower. Guests give particular credit for the soft beds, cold A/C and clean bathrooms. Because the building is set back from the main road, it's quiet and easy to sleep. Worth knowing: rooms are compact and the soundproofing between rooms isn't thick, so a group taking several rooms may hear each other a little.
"Very clean room, soft bed, cold A/C, quiet and easy to sleep. The owner was so kind, and there were free bikes to ride over to the temple. Great value."

What guests praise again and again is the warm, attentive owner and staff. Many reviews mention how friendly they are, that they speak enough English to communicate, and that they help with restaurant and travel tips. A touch international visitors especially like is the free loaner bicycles for riding to the stupa or around town. There's a restaurant, massage service, a garden and a 24-hour front desk. Breakfast earns praise from guests who pick a package that includes it, but some starting rates don't include breakfast, so check when you book.

Location is the main advantage for pilgrims. The hotel is in That Phanom town, walkable to the stupa and the town market, with Thai-Lao restaurants nearby for dinner. There's free parking on site, handy if you drive. The trade-off to keep in mind: That Phanom is a small district some distance from Mueang Nakhon Phanom (the riverfront, the Phaya Sri Sattanakharat naga monument, the walking street), about a 50-minute drive. If your main plan is the riverside in town, this is a bit far — but if your goal is Phra That Phanom, the location is ideal.

Plainly put, Na That Phanom Place is a simple stay selling cleanliness, quiet and a walkable spot near Phra That Phanom at an affordable price — not a hotel with full resort facilities. There's no pool, rooms are compact, the soundproofing is thin, and a few reviews note slow night-shift staff. But if you come to That Phanom to visit the temple and make merit, and want a clean, quiet room with a caring owner on a budget — especially couples, small families and older travellers who want to stay near the stupa — it delivers what you need.

A tip from reading the reviews: to visit Phra That Phanom in the morning, borrow one of the hotel's free bikes and ride over — no driving, no parking to find. Check at booking whether your rate includes breakfast, since the breakfast is well liked and worth it for a small add-on. If you're a group wanting quiet, pick upper-floor or non-adjacent rooms. And if you come during the Phra That Phanom homage festival (around February) or the end-of-Lent period, in-town stays fill fast, so book several weeks ahead.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Na That Phanom Place Hotel

faq.q: Where is Na That Phanom Place Hotel and how far is Phra That Phanom?
faq.a: It sits at 117 Moo 10, Chayangkul Road, in That Phanom town, Nakhon Phanom province. It's about 650 metres from Wat Phra That Phanom, a roughly 9-minute walk, or you can borrow a free hotel bike. Mueang Nakhon Phanom (the riverfront and naga monument) is about a 50-minute drive away.

faq.q: What is the starting price at Na That Phanom Place Hotel and what rooms are there?
faq.a: From approx. THB 850/night for a standard double. Twin and superior rooms run around THB 900-1,050, and family/extra-bed rooms around THB 1,300. Prices vary by season and whether breakfast is included, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does Na That Phanom Place Hotel have bikes and parking?
faq.a: Yes. The hotel has free loaner bicycles for riding to Wat Phra That Phanom or around town, and free parking on site, handy if you drive. There's also a massage service, a garden and a 24-hour front desk.

faq.q: What are the rooms and cleanliness like?
faq.a: Guests especially praise the cleanliness, soft beds, cold A/C and clean bathrooms. Rooms are simply and tidily furnished, and the building sits back from the main road, so it's quiet and easy to sleep. Worth knowing: rooms are compact and the soundproofing between rooms isn't thick.

faq.q: Who is Na That Phanom Place Hotel best for?
faq.a: Best for pilgrims visiting Phra That Phanom, couples, small families and older travellers who want a clean, quiet room within walking distance of the stupa, on a budget, with a caring owner and bikes to borrow. If your main plan is the riverside in Mueang Nakhon Phanom, it may be a bit far.

faq.q: What should I know before booking Na That Phanom Place Hotel?
faq.a: It's a small 25-room hotel with basic facilities and no pool. Rooms are compact, soundproofing is thin, and a few reviews note slow night-shift staff. That Phanom is about 50 minutes from Mueang Nakhon Phanom. During the Phra That Phanom homage festival (around February) and end of Lent, rooms fill fast, so book ahead.
